issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): Problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies an abstract method messageOnFeed() that returns a String (the textual feed message to be printed). In the solution repository, Animal.java declares the method as public abstract FeedResponse messageOnFeed() and a new FeedResponse class is introduced (FeedResponse.java). This contradicts the exercise specification and will confuse students about whether they should implement messageOnFeed() to return a String or a FeedResponse and how to print the feed message in Farm.feedAllAnimals() / singFarmSong().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type for messageOnFeed() consistent across all artifacts. Preferred (preserves the exercise text and UML): change Animal.messageOnFeed() in the solution to return String, remove the FeedResponse type (or stop using it), and update Pig.java and Seal.java to return the specified String messages (e.g., "Oink!", "Arf Arf!", "Maah!"). Update Farm.feedAllAnimals() and singFarmSong() to print those String messages. Alternatively, if FeedResponse is desired, update the problem statement, UML, and instructions to document FeedResponse and how to extract/print its message.

issues.description: Internal return type inconsistency inside the solution repository: Animal.messageOnFeed() is declared to return FeedResponse in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java, Pig.java and Seal.java implement messageOnFeed() returning FeedResponse, but Goat.java overrides messageOnFeed() with a signature that returns String. This mixed return-type implementation violates Java method override rules and will cause a compilation error (Goat does not correctly override Animal.messageOnFeed()).
issues.suggestedFix: Make all implementations use the same return type as Animal.messageOnFeed(). Preferred fix aligned with the exercise text: change Animal.messageOnFeed() to return String and update Pig.java and Seal.java to return String messages (remove FeedResponse). If FeedResponse is to be used, change Goat.messageOnFeed() to return FeedResponse (wrapping the String) so that all subclasses match the Animal signature. Ensure the solution compiles and that Farm.feedAllAnimals() / singFarmSong() handle the chosen type consistently.
